courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 船舶艙室防火分區
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以板材導熱與厚度建立起點，接到冷熱側能量閉合的系統介面，最後用材料試片與整艙性能界線整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Panel conductivity and thickness, connect through Cold/hot energy closure, then integrate evidence using Coupon versus whole-tank performance. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: LNG 船低溫絕熱結構
history.text: 本專題以板材導熱與厚度建立起點，接到冷熱側能量閉合的系統介面，最後用材料試片與整艙性能界線整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Panel conductivity and thickness, connect through Cold/hot energy closure, then integrate evidence using Coupon versus whole-tank performance. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 以熱阻、接縫和蒸發質量帳分析低溫絕熱，不把單片材料導熱率當整艙表現。 在低溫絕熱與熱漏數位室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Analyze cryogenic insulation using thermal resistance, joints and boil-off balances rather than one material conductivity. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Cryogenic insulation/heat-leak digital laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
